content.short: Midao helps DAOs incorporate in the Marshall Islands, the only sovereign nation that explicitly recognizes DAOs.
content.description: DAOs often struggle to gain legal recognition or be incorporated in traditional jurisdictions, where blockchain-based organizations lack formal status. To address this, Midao helped pass the DAO Act in 2022, creating LLC-style legislation in the Republic of the Marshall Islands that explicitly recognizes blockchain entities and DAOs. Midao assists DAOs with incorporation in the RMI, delivering corporate personhood, limited liability protections, and tax-entity status for blockchain ventures.
content.meta: Midao helps DAOs incorporate under Marshall Islands LLC rules recognizing blockchain. Discover Midao and other Web3 Service Providers on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
